name: import-modes-list
description: test.md import lists (branch we-import-checks): flat.w3x with 13 imports of every kind of path (make-import-modes.mjs: plain, _HD.w3mod\, _hd.w3mod\, _DE.w3mod\, _Teen.w3mod\, _teen.w3mod\, _HD.w3mod\_Teen.w3mod\, _locales\enus.w3mod\, a plain import and an _HD twin of a game path, a text file); the editor opens and saves it and keeps every entry with its flags (its Asset Manager lists them: Mode HD for _HD.w3mod\, DE for _DE.w3mod\, SD for the lower-case spellings and _locales, Teen Yes only for the game's spelling _Teen.w3mod\; TESTING.md); Studio saves it as it is

name: import-modes-import
description: test.md import lists (branch we-import-checks): a model imported into flat.w3x by the editor's Asset Manager (F12, File > Import File Ctrl+I: no question, the file lands at war3mapImported\<name>, Mode SD, however the folder it came from is named) and by Studio's Import Manager (w3.imports.add): the same entry and flags in the saved list

steps.eval: const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); w3.window.pickFiles = async () => ['${REPO}/target/import-modes/Rabbit.mdx']; await w3.commands.execute('w3.imports.open'); let b = null; for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !b; i++) { b = [...document.querySelectorAll('.imp-editor:not([hidden]) button')].find((x) => x.textContent === 'Import files…'); if (!b) await wait(100); } if (!b) throw new Error('no Import files button'); b.click(); for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) { if (w3.workspace.files().some((f) => /war3mapImported\/Rabbit\.mdx$/i.test(f.path.replace(/\\/g, '/')))) break; await wait(100); } await wait(1000);
await w3.editors.saveAll(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1000));
